youtube.title: Salam Dulu, Dimas! | Kakek Hasan dan Dimas #2
youtube.description:
Pulang dari masjid, Dimas langsung masuk rumah. Kakek Hasan memanggilnya kembali ke pintu.

Maukah kalian aku tunjukkan sesuatu yang membuat kalian saling mencintai? Sebarkan salam di antara kalian. (HR. Muslim 54)

#KakekHasanDanDimas #KisahIslami #JOTA #shorts

sources: HR. Muslim 54, dari Abu Hurairah: a wa la adullukum 'ala syai'in idza fa'altumuhu tahababtum? afsyus salama bainakum. Sahih. Dicek 2026-11-06 di hadeethenc.com/ar/browse/hadith/3361

kamera.posisi: in front of the house door at chest height, medium shot

klip.awal: Dimas stands on the doormat in front of the closed wooden front door, his back to the camera.

aksi.aksi: Dimas pushes the wooden door open with his right hand and steps forward through the doorway into the house.

klip.akhir: The front door stands open and the doorway is empty.

foley.suara: quick footsteps on a tiled floor

kamera.posisi: in front of the house at chest height, medium shot
kamera.fokus: Kakek Hasan by the potted plant

klip.awal: Kakek Hasan stands upright beside the potted plant in front of the open door, facing the camera at a slight three-quarter angle.

aksi.aksi: Kakek Hasan raises his right hand and waves it gently once toward the doorway.

klip.akhir: Kakek Hasan stands with his right hand lowered again.

foley.suara: soft fabric rustle of a raised sleeve

kamera.posisi: in the doorway at chest height, medium shot

klip.awal: Dimas stands in the open doorway facing the camera at a slight three-quarter angle, his hands at his sides.

aksi.aksi: Dimas walks forward two steps onto the doormat and stops.
Only after he stops, he tilts his head to the side.

klip.akhir: Dimas stands on the doormat, facing the camera.

kamera.posisi: in front of the house at chest height, medium shot

klip.awal: Kakek Hasan stands upright beside the potted plant facing the camera at a slight three-quarter angle, both hands resting together in front of him.

aksi.aksi: Kakek Hasan raises his right index finger once.

ucapan.text: Sebelum masuk rumah, ucapkan salam dulu. Biar rumah kita penuh berkah.

klip.akhir: Kakek Hasan stands calmly with both hands together again.

kamera.posisi: in front of the house door at chest height, medium shot

klip.awal: Dimas stands on the doormat right in front of the open wooden door, his back to the camera.

aksi.aksi: Dimas knocks twice on the open wooden door with his right fist.
Only after knocking, he steps through the doorway slowly.

klip.akhir: Dimas stands just inside the doorway.
